resources.string: Current formula, palette, and smooth coloring

Navigating the fractal

• Pan — drag with one finger. A live preview follows your finger; the full render finishes after you lift.

• Pinch zoom — use two fingers. Zoom stays anchored on the midpoint between your fingers. The zoom commits when you lift the last finger.

• Double-tap — zoom in on the tapped point.

• Long-press — show complex coordinates under your finger; lift to dismiss.

Bottom bar (HUD)

• + / − — zoom in or out about the screen center.
• Reset — return to the initial viewport.
• Smooth — toggle continuous iteration coloring (icon highlighted when on).
• ☰ Menu — formula, palette, export, help, and about.

Status overlay

The top-left panel shows the current formula, palette, and smooth setting. Tap to hide; tap ··· to show again.

Render progress

After you lift your finger, a thin bar at the top fills while the fractal re-renders (steps 8→4→2→1). It hides when the frame is ready or when a new gesture starts.

Export

Menu → Export → Share or Save to gallery. Captures the fractal view only.

Privacy

No network, ads, or analytics. Everything runs on your device.
